reviews: Beautiful Dress This dress is different than my normal choice but I loved it.  It fit perfect and my husband loved it as well (he usually don't say much about what I wear).  It was comfortable especially since I'm bigger at the bottom than on top.  I loved the lace detail as well!

Perfect! I loved this dress. SO comfortable w/pockets.  I am heavier on the bottom and this hides it all.  I'm also, 5'5" and the 6 fit perfectly - hit above my knee... high enough to be a little sexy without being too uncomfortable or showing too much.  Great dress.  It is thick material and might be a bit much for hot summer weather.

It was rainy and cool-so this dress ended up being perfect! I usually wear an 8, and I did fit in the 8, but it was tight.  I felt like I may not be able to move like I wanted.  I opted to wear the 10 and I felt comfortable the whole night.  Everyone loved the dress!  The color of blue was amazing!  It was such a rich cobalt blue, the pictures on the website just do not do it justice.

Felt beautiful in this beautiful dress! The dress runs pretty true to size.  Ordered the 10 and the 8, ended up wearing the 8.  Sleeves are a tad tight, but nothing major.  If anything, they made my arms look even smaller in pictures..plus!  The skirt is full, so if you are a tad "hippy", it could make you feel wider, however the waist does flatter an hourglass figure.  Wore this to a wedding and while I did feel like it was a bit more modest than other dresses, I felt very beautiful and classy.
Great style for the season.  Very comfortable, LOVE the pockets, would wear again!
I absolutely loved this dress! I did not want to return it when the night was over! I think this fit would be perfect for any body type. It was just a simple, gorgeous option!

Crowd Pleaser Beautiful dress and came in perfect condition. Was really happy with the customer service and quality. 

The four fit me the best in they body, but the arms were way too tight (as other reviewers have noted). I felt as though I might rip the sleeves if I moved around to much so I opted for the six. 

While the six fit me best in the arms, it was loose in the body and chest, which I think made me look wider. Overall I got a lot of compliments and the dress photographed really well.

Perfect, comfortable dress! This dress had a little give to it, so it was comfortable, which was perfect for a cocktail event at the Science Center! The arms were a little tight, but still fit. Overall, perfect dress.

Beautiful blue color! The fit was very true to size. The arms are not tight if you have smaller arms. The sleeves were not tight or uncomfortable on me. The pockets were an awesome surprise! 

The size 4 and 2 were slightly different colors. The size 2 was slightly worn and faded. The size 4 was a beautiful color and the dress looked brand new. I would def wear this dress again. Wonderful experience!
Flattering fit! This dress was PERFECT for a rehearsal dinner! The fit was flattering, and it has POCKETS!!! In all seriousness, this may be one of my favorite RTR dresses yet!

Beautiful color, great fit, awesome dress! I rented this dress for an outdoor dance and liked it even more than I thought I would! I agree with the other reviewers that it's tight in the arms. I have broad shoulders and muscular arms, but actually wound up wearing the smaller of the two sizes because I felt like the arms in the both sizes were about the same and the body of the smaller size fit better. I also agree that it's a warm fabric, which was perfect for my event. Overall, I got a ton of compliments and felt great in it. I would highly recommend it!

An excellent first RTR experience!!  Wore this to an outdoor fall wedding, and it was perfect! The material is gorgeous in person, and the dress is very well made. The arms were a little tight if I wanted to raise my arms over my head, but the 0 fit perfectly in every other way. Loved it!

Went to a wedding and this was the perfect dress for it I wore this to a winter wedding and have never had SO MANY compliments on a dress. People I didn't know were stopping me to tell me they loved it. The dress is VERY CURVE FRIENDLY. I'm a size 14 and very pear shaped, this is the perfect dress for pear shaped women. It hits you at the rib cage and flows out, hiding any bumps. Added bonus: it has pockets as you can see in my photo. The dress was amazing, would highly recommend.

I was nervous to order this because other reviewers said it was tight in the arms and I have heavier arms, but I did not find the sleeves tight at all, I thought the dress ran true to size.

I am on the left. It's a nice flowing and flattering fit. I loved it. It's true to size. It's comfy and forgiving yet dressy. It was nice for a breezy Spring party, but I wouldn't wear it when it gets warmer. The lining is not sheer, so it would be too hot.
I got a ton of compliments.It's a bright royal blue The size 6 looked fine on me, but the size 4 fit was tighter and felt better.

Classy and fabulous dress fit like a glove, true to size. I wore it to a wedding got so many compliments on it, it is on trend for the season and a fabulous color. Comfortable material, form fitting without feeling tight, and easy to dance in. I am going to rent it again!

Amazing night, fantastic dress This dress could not have fit me more perfectly and I got compliments on it all night. I have broad shoulders, so I was a little apprehensive, but I didn't have a problem. The blue is much brighter in person, which I loved. My only complaint is that the zipper sucked. I needed help getting it zipped up and unzipped just because the zipper kept getting stuck.

Perfect for my son's baptism.  Both the size 6 and size 8 fit in the dress for me, the 8 being just a bit more comfortable in the chest and a more conservative length for the church event. It's very well made and warm, so if renting in the summer beware. Color is beautiful. Overall, I would recommend.

Gorgeous dress! I loved this dress, very classy for a winter wedding.  My only complaint is that I am broad in the shoulders and it was a bit tight.  The fabric is not stretchy at all.  Other than that, it was very comfortable.

Perfect for fall wedding! Thank goodness I added it! I am SO thankful that I added this dress as a "second style" to my rental because the style that was my first choice just didn't fit right. This dress was perfect for an early fall wedding - the dress felt awesome when it was on - very comfortable. The pockets were super cute and the lace was gorgeous - I got several compliments. The blue is a little more "electric cobalt" than the picture is - so it really pops. I wore it with the pictured Kate Spade necklace and a nude pump ... I felt like a total 10!
The dress was perfect! Very comfortable to wear and dance in the entire night.  The arms were a little too tight in the 4 so I ended up wearing the 6. Other than that the dress runs true to size.

Beautiful blue color and comfortable dress. I got this dress as a "backup" an ultimately decided to go with my first choice, hence no picture to share. The dress was a pretty blue, pattering to my hourglass figure. It was comfortable in the bust (I am large-busted) and in the arms which can be a problem area in dresses with similar sleeve lengths. The A-line swing skirt was great at concealing a small tummy, and would be even better with Spanx. I ultimately decided on the other gown because I'm approaching 30 and my legs are not my best feature- the dress is short and would be great for a young gal and/or a lady with heat legs!

Compliments but not without pain The 4 fit but the arms were too tight so I had to wear the 6. It is incredibly hot, 4 layers of fabric total, so keep that in mind when wearing it. Other than that, it was a nice dress.

I loved the dress, it fit well, and it had pockets! I loved this dress. It's a bit on the heavy side, because it's fully lined, so definitely not an option for a summery event. But it fit me well. I loved that it had pockets! I hate that I ordered it, loved it, couldn't wait to wear it to the wedding...and then my 10 month old was sick, so we stayed home.

Fabulous dress!!! The dress was gorgeous and fit comfortably everywhere except the arms, which were tight.  If the 14 had been available for rental that would have been the perfect size.  I got tons of compliments and would definitely this dress again!

Perfect Dress~ This dress fit perfectly and was very comfortable. 
I have a larger chest (after 2 kids) and this dress fit perfectly over it with no pulling or anything. 
The sleeve length was perfect for a fall night out in Chicago.
Very easy to sit in and walk around. The color was amazing. Lots of compliments and likes on the dress.

Beautiful color!  The color of this dress is so vibrant in person! The lace is also beautiful and it was perfect for an April wedding. My only complaint was that the sleeves were very tight. Size up if you think that will be problematic.
This dress looked super cute on, but I hated the way in looked in pictures!  wouldn't recommend, especially to a tall girl

This dress!!! I loved this dress. It's amazing. It has pockets! The color is very pretty, I got a lot of compliments on it. I'm 5'8" and it hit a little above my knees, but not too short. I could probably have gotten away with my normal size 18 but it would've been a little tight in the bust. To be fair though I'm large chested, so a lot of things run tight in the bust. I'd definitely recommend this dress.

I wore this to my friends wedding and I loved it!!  This was my first RTR experience and to say i was a little nervous was an understatement.  I've never purchased a dress without trying it on first.  I am very critical of myself in dresses so I poured over all the reviews of the dress which were so helpful.  As beautiful as the model always looks  it is so nice to see how it fit and looked on people of all different shapes and sizes and i have to say the dress really compliments everyone so well.  I have to admit it was a little warm for a June wedding but I wanted something with sleeves.  The design of the dress was so ornate and beautifully made.  The color was way more stunning in person than it shows on the website.  I would absolutely rent this dress again.  This might be my new obsession!!
